stem:
Padma cuts a paper rectangle into two triangles and rearranges those same pieces into a parallelogram with no gaps and no overlaps.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Same area is only a label for the activity, not a conclusion about the pieces.
The rearranged parallelogram has the same total area as the original rectangle.
Matching the two triangles on top of each other shows that the two pieces have equal areas.
The question asks for perimeter, so add the outer lengths of the parallelogram.

teacher.key_rationale: Rearrangement without gaps or overlaps keeps total area. Matching triangles shows equal piece areas. Naming same area is not a claim. Perimeter is a different hinge.
